topic: Organizer HTML explicitly lists 2006-2011 finalists' authored essay collections separately from final essay prompts. Raw titles distinguish participant_work vs task; the PDFs have not been opened and publication does not grant reuse rights.

Historical archive enumerates problems for selected years 2012-2024, but Solutions section points to published participant work in a Zenodo community and videos, not an official solution corpus. Year-round completeness and reuse rights remain unknown.

scope: Czech Young Physicists Tournament older rounds
topic: Official Czech TMF archive explicitly says transfer from historical websites is still in progress. Links to Zadání exist for many years but no complete per-year/per-stage/participant-report matrix has been verified.

Official ONF Os Ensaios HTML names gold/silver/bronze essay winners for 2023-2026, but public text does not expose downloadable winning essay links. Ao longo dos anos timeline contains inconsistent edition/year labels (e.g. 201/2012 and XI 2025/26), so chronology needs reconciliation.

BDEO 2025 public HTML links question papers for 2022, 2023, 2024 on Google Drive, while 2025 selection exam is explicitly marked Not Working Now. Do not treat 2025 task paper as accessible or 2022-2024 solutions as confirmed.

Official Young Mathematician camp archive lists 2005-2025 downloadable annual materials including problem statements and lecture themes. These are mixed training/camp records, not proven year-by-year competitive Olympiad task sets; archive payloads and rights not inspected.

scope: El Salvador UES 2025-2026 source registry provenance
topic: Prior r279 discovery deferred two Universidad de El Salvador archive URLs because mathematics live HTML returned 502 and chemistry archive had not been enumerated. The subsequent crawler merger inserted both into sources.jsonl with search_indexed status; they must not be counted as live-verified archives.

Independent IYPT research archive offers restored/translated problem metadata for 1988-1993 and notes all rights belong to original owners. Compare against modern official IYPT problems by edition before treating distinct URL versions as independent works.

scope: Paraguay national and regional physics rounds 2024-2026
topic: Association organizer page lists dated national/regional rounds and result PDFs but no verified archive of actual competition questions, solutions or grading rubrics. Results are not task materials.

Organizer navigation links winners for 2022-2025 and current research-project competition information. Public HTML index does not establish availability of submitted student projects or evaluation rubrics; avoid labeling winners' pages as participant_work.

scope: Unverified alternative IMO and AI-derived math mirrors
topic: EulerSolve IMO archive was search-indexed but live access failed; wisesoftware.imo-official.com problem page timed out. Polish OMJ Validator explicitly warns that problem texts/hints/evaluations are AI-generated and may contain errors. Do not promote these as independently verified official source archives.
